request.query: A visitor is coming to the Lahore office tomorrow. How do they get on the guest Wi-Fi?

documents.title: Guest Wi-Fi in the Lahore office · Steps
documents.text:
## Steps
The Lahore office has no reception desk. Visitors join NW-Guest-LHE and the hosting employee requests a guest code from the IT channel in Teams; the code lasts for the length of the visit. The NW-Guest one-day codes do not work in Lahore.

documents.title: Guest Wi-Fi for visitors · Steps
documents.text:
## Steps
Visitors join the NW-Guest network and sign in with a one-day code that reception prints from the visitor system. Codes expire at midnight. Employees never share their own corporate Wi-Fi certificate with visitors.

documents.title: Lahore office network and power backup · Notes
documents.text:
## Notes
During scheduled power load-shedding, the Lahore office runs on generator power and the main switch restarts once. Wi-Fi returns within two minutes. If the VPN drops at the same time, reconnect after the Wi-Fi is back rather than resetting the profile.

documents.title: Corporate Wi-Fi asks for a certificate · Fix
documents.text:
## Fix
Choose the network "Northwind-Corp" and accept the certificate issued to "radius.northwind.example". If the laptop shows a different certificate name, do not connect and tell the help desk.

documents.title: Get access to a SharePoint site · Steps
documents.text:
## Steps
Open the site link and click **Request access**. The site owner gets an email and usually approves within one working day. The help desk cannot add you to a site without the owner's approval.

documents.title: Request sudo on an engineering workstation · Policy
documents.text:
## Policy
Engineers get time-limited sudo through the access portal with team lead approval. The help desk cannot grant sudo directly.

documents.title: VPN drops every few minutes on macOS · If it still drops
documents.text:
## If it still drops
If the VPN still drops after the reset, the problem is usually the network you are on. Try a phone hotspot for five minutes. If the hotspot is stable, the issue is your local Wi-Fi; if not, raise a ticket so Network Operations can check your account.

documents.title: Payroll portal outage: current status · Workaround
documents.text:
## Workaround
Expense claims can be submitted by email to the finance shared mailbox; they will be processed when the portal is back. Payroll itself runs on schedule; salaries are not affected.

documents.title: Mac says the disk is almost full · Fix
documents.text:
## Fix
1. Open **System Settings > General > Storage** and review the recommendations.
2. Empty the Trash and the Downloads folder.
3. Turn on **Optimize Mac Storage** for OneDrive files so they stay in the cloud until opened.

documents.title: Outlook not syncing on Windows · Fix
documents.text:
## Fix
1. Check **File > Office Account** shows your Northwind account. Sign out and back in if it shows an error.
2. Turn off **Work Offline** on the Send/Receive tab.
3. Close Outlook, then open it while holding **Ctrl** and choose **Yes** to start in safe mode. If it syncs in safe mode, disable add-ins one at a time.
4. If nothing helps, use **Account settings > Repair**.
